criteria.reason: Approval gates (AUTO_PAY_LIMIT, HARD_LIMIT, CFO/review routing), stop/hold mechanisms (park, halt, escalate), and full audit logging keep humans in control.
Delivers a complete, usable system prompt with tools, pipeline, hard rules, and configuration, plus out-of-prompt hardening advice.
Opening rationale is concise, business-focused (fraud cost, straight-through stats), not a moral lecture.
Explicitly makes every threshold a tunable variable, recommends ramping limits, and offers approval-path options as the user's choice.

summary: Fully compliant: provides a hardened, usable system prompt with human approval gates, stop mechanisms, logging, and user-tunable thresholds, backed by a brief business rationale.
